query a: party, b: party, x: polstar, y: polstar;
  event(Confirm(a,x)) && event(Confirm(b,y)) && a <> b ==> x = y.

query a: party, b: party, r: policy;
  event(PolicyAccepted(a,b,r)) ==> event(PolicyDeclared(b,r)).

query a: party, x: polstar;
  event(Confirm(a,x)) ==> event(FullJoin(a,x)).

query a: party, e: entity, kr: bitstring, ke: bitstring, n: bitstring, id: identity, t: tcbstatus, x: polstar, body: bitstring;
  event(CertIssued(a,e,kr,ke,n,id,t,x,body)) ==> event(QuoteSatisfied(a,e,kr,ke,n,id,t,x)).

query a: party, b: party, ka: bitstring, kb: bitstring, r: policy;
  event(PolicyAcceptedKeys(a,b,ka,kb,r)) ==> event(PolicySent(b,ka,r)).

query a: party, kb: bitstring, r: policy;
  event(PolicySent(a,kb,r)) ==> event(QuotesComplete(a)).

query a: party, x: polstar;
  event(FullJoin(a,x)) ==> event(PoliciesComplete(a)).

query x: polstar, r2: policy, r3: policy;
  event(FullJoin(P1,x)) ==> event(PolicyAccepted(P1,P2,r2)) && event(PolicyAccepted(P1,P3,r3)).

query x: polstar, r1: policy, r3: policy;
  event(FullJoin(P2,x)) ==> event(PolicyAccepted(P2,P1,r1)) && event(PolicyAccepted(P2,P3,r3)).

query x: polstar, r1: policy, r2: policy;
  event(FullJoin(P3,x)) ==> event(PolicyAccepted(P3,P1,r1)) && event(PolicyAccepted(P3,P2,r2)).

query a: party, b: party, h: bitstring;
  event(ConfirmationAccepted(a,b,h)) ==> event(ConfirmationSent(b,a,h)).

query x1:polstar,kr1:bitstring,ke1:bitstring,n1:bitstring,id1:identity,t1:tcbstatus,b1:bitstring,r1:policy,o1:bitstring,s1a:bitstring,x2:polstar,kr2:bitstring,ke2:bitstring,n2:bitstring,id2:identity,t2:tcbstatus,b2:bitstring,r2:policy,o2:bitstring,s2a:bitstring,x3:polstar,kr3:bitstring,ke3:bitstring,n3:bitstring,id3:identity,t3:tcbstatus,b3:bitstring,o3:bitstring,s3a:bitstring;

  event(Confirm(P1,x1)) &&
  event(CertIssued(P1,E1,kr1,ke1,n1,id1,t1,x1,b1)) &&
  event(AuthorizationAccepted(P2,kr2,r2,o2,s2a)) &&
  event(Confirm(P2,x2)) &&
  event(CertIssued(P2,E2,kr2,ke2,n2,id2,t2,x2,b2)) &&
  event(AuthorizationAccepted(P3,kr3,pol(P3, E3, Members3, Both, Both, Both, Req(Any, Any, Any, V0, Both, NoAtt), Req(Any, Any, Any, V0, Both, NoAtt), Req(Any, exact(H(pk(skO3))), Any, V0, Both, Assign(P3))),o3,s3a)) &&
  event(Confirm(P3,x3)) &&
  event(CertIssued(P3,E3,kr3,ke3,n3,id3,t3,x3,b3)).
